PF2E_NA.Title: Inspiration

enabled.Name: Enable Narrative Assistant
enabled.Hint: Suggests a description after supported PF2e rolls.

output.Name: Output
output.Hint: Where suggestions go. The panel sits at the top of the chat sidebar on the GM's screen, writes nothing to the chat, and is cleared on reload. A suggestion about a secret roll is never public.

source.Name: Narrative source
source.Hint: Module tables, or world tables carrying the same key (import a table from the compendium to customise it).

cast.Name: Events: spell casts without a roll
cast.Hint: Heal on an ally, Haste… Spells with an attack or a save are narrated on that roll.

finish.Name: Events: finishing blows
finish.Hint: When a creature drops to 0 HP during combat.

persistent.Name: Events: persistent damage checks
persistent.Hint: The flat check to end persistent damage (fire, bleed, acid…).

revive.Name: Events: back from 0 HP
revive.Hint: When a player character loses the Dying condition while above 0 HP.

combat.Name: Events: combat start and end
combat.Hint: One scene-setting line when a combat starts and when it is ended.

disabledActions.Name: Disabled actions
disabledActions.Hint: Comma-separated PF2e action slugs, e.g.: seek, hide, sneak, recall-knowledge.

language.Name: Narration language
language.Hint: Language of the descriptions, independent of the UI. Falls back to English when no corpus exists for that language.

criticalSuccess.Name: Chance: critical success
criticalSuccess.Hint: Percentage of critical successes that get a suggestion (0 = never).

success.Name: Chance: success
success.Hint: Percentage of successes that get a suggestion. Lower it to keep long fights readable.

failure.Name: Chance: failure
failure.Hint: Percentage of failures that get a suggestion.

criticalFailure.Name: Chance: critical failure
criticalFailure.Hint: Percentage of critical failures that get a suggestion.

saveGroupDelay.Name: Group saves (seconds)
saveGroupDelay.Hint: Saves against the same spell or effect made within this many seconds of each other share one card, one line per creature. 0 = one card per save.

PF2E_NA.SourceMissing: That roll is no longer in the chat log.
PF2E_NA.Ask: Suggest a narration for this roll
